Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her wearing the game cosplay chosen in SCENE — a daring adult cosplay of the named video-game character, as worn to a cosplay convention, a photo shoot or a night in. In this cut the outfit itself shows that game character: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. She is a woman wearing that character's cosplay — she is not that character. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image. LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.

EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy

action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

The cosplay must read at first glance as that game character's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit; her face and hair colour stay exactly as in the attached image and her body follows the BODY TYPE line — never the character's face, hair colour or body, no wig, no logo or readable text.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No Pokémon, animals or other creatures, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.
